vllm_install.recipe: uv venv --python 3.12 --seed --managed-python ~/vllm-0.33.0-venv; uv pip install --python ~/vllm-0.33.0-venv/bin/python vllm==0.33.0 --torch-backend=cu130
references: docs/guide/install-engines.md engine installation section (linked from docs/operations/install.md)

bonsai_agreement.implementation: Custom C++ scorer linked against the requested llama.cpp build, using llama_decode with output logits enabled at every answer-predicting position and llama_get_logits_ith to take the raw vocabulary argmax. Exact saved prompt_ids and BF16 answer_ids are supplied; the preceding BF16 tokens, not Bonsai's generated tokens, define every prefix. Token vocabulary compatibility is checked before scoring.
bonsai_agreement.difference_from_vllm: Same teacher-forcing and unsampled argmax definition; native llama.cpp CUDA kernels, GGUF loader/Hadamard rotation and batching replace vLLM's backend. Recurrent-state and numeric implementation details remain backend-specific; results are not a within-engine quantization-only comparison.

accuracy.method: Original b18.py GSM8K and tools request/scoring functions, with timing fields omitted from serialization only; prompts, answer limits and scorer logic unchanged.

limits: Unified-memory GB10 cannot qualify a discrete-GPU utilization floor.
Existing user training runs throughout; no timing, throughput or memory measurements are qualified or reported.
CPU and Fake-engine tests are not qualification; the requested checks use native GPU engines.
